channel.title: Which AI Map weekly
channel.description: What changed in AI models, agents, MCP and tools, minus the hype.

item.title: OpenAI models arrive on Google Cloud, Kimi K3.1 Pro launches
item.description: OpenAI broadened its enterprise reach by making its frontier models directly available on Google Cloud, while Anthropic expanded its unified Claude Cowork workspace. Moonshot AI launched Kimi K3.1 Pro with faster inference tiers for reasoning tasks. Tooling updates also gave developers more flexibility to integrate custom models and low-cost logic into everyday workflows.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon release and Claude agent updates
item.description: This week brought significant new model capability releases alongside essential tooling updates for AI agents. These developments give practitioners better ways to build, monitor, and execute complex workflows in production.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with an interactive interface
item.description: OpenAI launched GPT-6 with interactive visual elements directly inside ChatGPT. Meanwhile, Anthropic connected Claude to Google Workspace and added interactive dashboards to its web workspace. These releases focus on making everyday assistant workflows faster and more visual without requiring technical setup.

item.title: OpenAI DevDay, GPT-6.1 Sol, and Gemini 4 Argon
item.description: Major new frontier models launched this week, led by OpenAI's DevDay announcements and the debut of GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon. These updates bring more capable coding agents and pricing adjustments for everyday users.

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 launch with price cuts
item.description: Anthropic released new flagship models alongside broad industry price drops of forty to fifty percent. Meanwhile, AMD acquired World Labs and GitHub integrated the new models into Copilot.
